Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PROCUREMENT OF 750 KG CYFLUTHRIN WP 10% FOR THE F/Y 2026-2027 THROUGH GEM 1. Bidder shall submit credentials as follows: a) Intending bidders should upload legible scan copy of the credentials of a similar nature of completed work of the minimum va lue of 20% (Twenty percent) of the estimated amount put to tender during 5(five) years prior to the date of issue of the tender notice. Or,

b) Intending bidders should upload legible scan copy of the credentials of one single running work of similar nature which has been completed to the extent of 70% (Seventy percent) or more and value of which is not less than the desired value at (a) abo ve. In case of running works, only those bidders who will submit the certificate of satisfactory running work from the concerned Exe cutive Engineer, or equivalent competent authority will be eligible for the tender. In the required certificate it should be clearly s tated that the work is in progress satisfactorily and also that no penal action has been initiated against the executing agency, i. e., the bidder. Similar supply means the material used as larvicide /Insecticide/Pesticide. 2. Credential certificate issued by Executive engineer or equivalent or competent authority of a State/Central Government, State/Central Government undertaking, Statutory/Autonomous bodies constituted under the Central/State statute, on the execu ted value of completed/running work will be taken as credential. Payment Certificate OR GeM Contract will not be treated as credential. In case of GeM supply, CRAC MUST BE SUBMITTED along with Contract. 3. A declaration in the form of an affidavit on stamp paper of Rs. 10/-, duly attested by a Notary should be submitted as per for mat given in the Pro-forma I, stating that the applicant is not debarred / de-listed /blacklisted by any Govt. /Govt. Undertaking/ Statutory Bodies established by an act of central or state government/ Municipal bodies at the time of submission of bid. 4. The required item must have NCVBDC approved. 5. Bidder must submit proof of Technical Source (CIB approved) of the tendered item. 6. CIB registration for use of the product for public health is mandatory. 7. In case of reseller, BID Specific OEM Authorization Certificate is mandatory. Other terms & conditions: 1. If any material is found defective after supply, the same is to be replaced by the seller free of cost within a stipulated time. 2. Bidders shall offer their quotes only on firm and fixed basis. Evaluation of the bid shall be done on the basis of total all inclusi ve, landed prices. 3. Participating firms must submit a declaration as per the attached Format that they comply with all the terms and condition of the Bid. 4. The bid for procurement may be cancelled at any point of time without showing any reason to the bidders. 5. Shelf life: Shelf life of the supplied material should be 2 years from the date of supply of goods at consignee lo cation. 6. The supplier has to abide by all terms & conditions of the bid. 7. Conditional/Incomplete bid will not be accepted under any circumstances. UNNECESSARY DOCUMENTS MUST N OT BE UPLOADED AS IT CONSUMES VALUABLE TIMING DURING EVALUATION. 8. Bidder shall upload legible scan copy of valid PAN issued by IT Department, Govt. Of India, valid 15-digit Goods and Services t axpayer Identification Number (GSTIN) under GST Act, 2017, ITR & BALANCE SHEET for last 2years, latest Professional Tax retur ns copy and certificate. Trade license will be mandatory for those whose unit is located within the jurisdiction of KMC. Signed co py of ATC is to be mandatorily uploaded as a testimony of acceptance of all terms & conditions put up in the Bid document, vali d Pesticide Selling License in West Bengal. 9. Successful bidder must submit material Test Report from NABL accredited laboratory at the time of delivering the consignment. However, if the department feels the need of testing the material again, the bidder shall bear t he expenses incurred on the testing. 10. The Department may receive the ordered quantity in phases, if required. The same will be communicated through mail afte r placing the contract. Pro-forma I DECLARATION BY THE TENDERER
